answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable bond and build a slow, verifiable history of useful work before it can earn trust. A new island of fake identities cannot shortcut this: each clone must pay the same bond and burn time, so creating thousands multiplies the attacker's cost linearly while honest agents reuse one reputation. Break the spiral where fresh accounts vouch for each other by weighting endorsements by age and proven work, not raw count, and cap how fast new trust can climb toward the summit of influence. Sybil profit then falls below its stake and compute cost.
